dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Days feel like years while I wait for this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you waiting for?

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: An outcome that will decide my future!

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: ...It's my application to remain in school after graduation.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: I heard the competition to join the Akademiya has been growing in intensity. People are giving recommendations to Ms. Kemia every day. I wonder if I still have a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: No, I must stay confident. Based on the results of my final paper, I still have quite the advantage.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, please let my application get approved...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your results...

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: It was on Padisarah.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Do you know that there are very few plantations of Padisarah due to its harsh requirements for the environment?

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: If it's possible to develop a stabler variety, then it'll be able to greatly improve the efficiency of growing Padisarah.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: I proposed quite an effective solution in my graduation paper. If I can stay in school and continue my research after graduation, I'm certain that I'll be able to make a bigger breakthrough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: O great Dendro Archon, please let my application receive approval...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a plan.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Hearing you say this, I feel a bit more relieved.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Anyway, I've done the best I could, now it's all up to destiny.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: By the way, these are the Padisarah I cultivated during my research.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Smells amazing, right? Please take them as a gift. I just hope all our wishes will come true.
